decks.title: A History of Western Society (from p406) (dragged)

cards.term: What political ideology emerged to oppose Metternich's revitalized conservatism?
cards.definition: Liberalism, nationalism, and socialism emerged to challenge conservatism.

cards.term: Which movement challenged the certainties of the Enlightenment and fed popular nationalism?
cards.definition: Romanticism captured the intensity of the era by challenging Enlightenment certainties.

cards.term: What was the main goal of the Quadruple Alliance after Napoleon's defeat?
cards.definition: The alliance aimed to rearm and hold France in line through a balance of power.

cards.term: How did Metternich justify his defense of the monarchical status quo?
cards.definition: He believed that organized religion and authoritarian governments were necessary to protect society from radical change.

cards.term: What specific decree was issued by the Holy Alliance in 1815 to repress liberal movements?
cards.definition: The Karlsbad Decrees clamped down on liberal nationalists in universities and the press.
